_comment: Weekly snapshots of the OPEN CommitFest, used to compute week-over-week deltas. Only the MOST RECENT week is kept in full (needed to track the fate of a patch flagged a week ago); every earlier week is collapsed to {week, cf, created_n, closed_n, net}. Full history lives in references/archive/commitfest-2026.json (not read at runtime).

weeks_summary.net: in-window: 4 committed, 2 withdrawn; multiple new records (UUID cluster, reorder-buffer perf, ANALYZE sampling hook, new GUC/aggregate proposals)
5 created vs 27 closed in covered span -> net -22 (queue draining as In Progress began; commit tempo ~6x last week's 4)

weeks.note: Both /62/activity/ and /61/activity/ return the SAME global 100-row log (identical head and tail rows), hard-capped, no pagination. Merged+deduped they give 162 distinct rows reaching back only to 2026-09-08 14:59 - so all of Sep 7 and most of Sep 8 are invisible. Flow numbers below are LOWER BOUNDS. The Status-summary queue totals on /<n>/?tag=zzz remain the reliable week-over-week signal. Also unresolved: whether either activity log is genuinely CF-scoped.

weeks.highlight: The four SQL/PGQ follow-on entries all died within three days of the Sep 7 revert - the CommitFest is where the revert's blast radius is visible. Separately, 'Support for 8-byte TOAST values, round two' went Ready for Committer on Sep 11, the same week the OID8 widening and the toast_value_type reloption landed in master.
